threads.name: The Influence of Francis Bartlett's Donations
threads.description: This theme explores how the donations by Francis Bartlett have contributed to the Museum's collection, specifically focusing on the acquisition of significant artifacts. The narrative begins with the purchase of a two-handled jar and a bronze statue using Bartlett's funds, highlighting his impact on the museum's early 20th-century acquisitions. The story turns with the addition of a sarcophagus or large urn, demonstrating the continued influence of his donations over time. The payoff is the understanding of Bartlett's lasting legacy within the museum's collection.
